dialogue.content: こんにちは　相談員です。ご相談にお越しいただきありがとうございます。今日はどのようなご相談でしょうか。
dialogue.English: Hello, I'm the counselor. Thank you for coming in for a consultation. What would you like to discuss today?

dialogue.content: もう疲れてしまいました
dialogue.English: I'm exhausted.

dialogue.content: 全部私が悪いのです
dialogue.English: It's all my fault.

dialogue.content: 疲れてしまったのですね。私が悪いと思われているんですね。
dialogue.English: So you're feeling exhausted. And you feel that it's all your fault.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: よろしかったら、ご年齢と性別を教えていただけないでしょうか。
dialogue.English: If it's alright with you, could you please tell me your age and gender?

dialogue.content: 50代後半男です
dialogue.English: I'm a man in my late 50s.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。疲れてしまったのは、お仕事上のことでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Thank you. Is this exhaustion related to your work?

dialogue.content: そうです
dialogue.English: Yes, it is.

dialogue.content: よろしければ、もうすこし詳しくお話を聞かせていただけないでしょうか。
dialogue.English: If you're comfortable, could you please tell me a bit more about it?

dialogue.content: コロナの影響で仕事が激減してしまった
dialogue.English: My work has drastically decreased due to the impact of COVID-19.

dialogue.content: コロナの影響なのですね。お仕事は営業のお仕事でしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see, it's due to COVID-19. Is your work in sales?

dialogue.content: 土木関係の仕事
dialogue.English: It's in civil engineering.

dialogue.content: 土木関係の現場のお仕事でしょうか？
dialogue.English: Is it on-site work in civil engineering?

dialogue.content: そうです
dialogue.English: Yes, it is.

dialogue.content: 最近は夏の暑さの中での仕事で
dialogue.English: Lately, I've been working in the summer heat.

dialogue.content: 今年は特に暑いですよね。
dialogue.English: This year has been especially hot, hasn't it?

dialogue.content: 体力的にもきつい
dialogue.English: It's physically demanding, too.

dialogue.content: それにマスクをしてのお仕事は大変ですよね。
dialogue.English: And working with a mask on must be very difficult.

dialogue.content: 毎日現場には行かれるのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Do you go to the worksite every day?

dialogue.content: いや家のローン事業の借金が残っている
dialogue.English: No—I still have my mortgage and business debts hanging over me.

dialogue.content: ローンと、それと事業の借金ですか。
dialogue.English: A mortgage, and business debts as well?

dialogue.content: そうです
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 収入が激減ということでしたが、それらの支払が滞るほどでしょうか？
dialogue.English: You mentioned your income has drastically decreased. Is it to the point where you're falling behind on those payments?

dialogue.content: 子どもへ仕送りもできない
dialogue.English: I can't even send money to my children.

dialogue.content: 仕送りもあるのですね。それは大変ですよね。
dialogue.English: I see you're also sending money to your children. That must be very difficult.

dialogue.content: 失礼ですが、奥様とはこのようなことはお話されたでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Forgive me for asking, but have you spoken with your wife about this?

dialogue.content: 全部わたしが悪い
dialogue.English: It's all my fault.

dialogue.content: 昨年の夏から妻は実家に帰ってしまっている
dialogue.English: Since last summer, my wife has been back at her parents' home.

dialogue.content: そう思われているのですね。コロナの仕事減は、あなたが悪いわけではないと思うのですが。
dialogue.English: I see that's how you feel. But I don't think the decrease in work due to COVID-19 is your fault.

dialogue.content: ごめんなさい。奥様はご実家に？
dialogue.English: I'm sorry—your wife is at her parents' home?

dialogue.content: そうです
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: なぜでしょうか？差し支えなければお聞かせ願えますか？
dialogue.English: May I ask why, if you don't mind sharing?

dialogue.content: 私が悪かった
dialogue.English: It was my fault.

dialogue.content: 妻はよく頑張ってくれていた
dialogue.English: My wife worked so hard for us.

dialogue.content: 奥様は頑張ってくださっていたのですね。
dialogue.English: So your wife was working very hard for you.

dialogue.content: 自分が勝手だった
dialogue.English: I was selfish.

dialogue.content: 勝手？さきほど事業の借金と仰っていましたが、どういうことでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Selfish? You mentioned business debts earlier; what do you mean?

dialogue.content: 事業の借金は返せると思っていた
dialogue.English: I thought I could repay the business debts.

dialogue.content: 自分にはそれぐらいできると
dialogue.English: I believed I was capable of that.

dialogue.content: コロナが無ければ、返せる計画の借金だったのですね？
dialogue.English: So if it weren't for COVID-19, these were debts you had a plan to repay, right?

dialogue.content: そう思いたい
dialogue.English: I'd like to think so.

dialogue.content: 個人事業主として、土木の現場で働いていらっしゃるということでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Does that mean you're working on civil engineering sites as a sole proprietor?

dialogue.content: 社員もいる
dialogue.English: I have employees, too.

dialogue.content: 面倒みてやっていたんだ
dialogue.English: I was taking care of them.

dialogue.content: 法人として経営をしていらっしゃるのですね？
dialogue.English: So you're running a corporation?

dialogue.content: 社員さんの面倒をみていらっしゃったのですね。
dialogue.English: I see you were taking care of your employees.

dialogue.content: みんな俺に着いてきてくれていた
dialogue.English: Everyone was following my lead.

dialogue.content: ああ、頼られるタイプの親分肌なのですね。
dialogue.English: Ah, so you're the dependable, boss-like type.

dialogue.content: どの位の金額の借金なのですか？よろしければ教えてください。
dialogue.English: How much debt is it, if you're comfortable sharing?

dialogue.content: 事業は5000万
dialogue.English: 50 million yen for the business.

dialogue.content: 住宅は3000万
dialogue.English: 30 million yen for the house.

dialogue.content: 残っている
dialogue.English: is still outstanding.

dialogue.content: 大きな金額ですね。返せると思っていたのに、コロナのせいで計画が狂ってしまったということですね。
dialogue.English: That's a large amount of money. So you thought you could pay it back, but your plans were derailed by COVID-19.

dialogue.content: 今となってはただ調子に乗っていただけだった
dialogue.English: Looking back now, I was just getting carried away.

dialogue.content: 調子に乗っていたとは？
dialogue.English: Getting carried away?

dialogue.content: 景気がいい時はみんなに奢ってやっていた
dialogue.English: When business was good, I would treat everyone.

dialogue.content: そういうものですよ。おごってやりたい気持ちわかります。
dialogue.English: That's just how it is. I understand the feeling of wanting to treat people.

dialogue.content: いまさらどうすれば
dialogue.English: What am I supposed to do now?

dialogue.content: 景気がいい時には、5000万まで貸してくれる金融機関があったのですよね？
dialogue.English: When the economy was good, financial institutions would lend you up to 50 million, right?

dialogue.content: 一件の仕事がでかいからそのくらいは必要
dialogue.English: Each project is large, so we need about that much.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。コロナの前から、仕掛り、途中の現場はあるのですか？
dialogue.English: I see. Are there any ongoing projects from before COVID-19?

dialogue.content: 遅れているのもあるが新しいものが入ってこない
dialogue.English: Some are delayed, but no new ones are coming in.

dialogue.content: 進行中の仕事はあるけれど、次への新しいお仕事が受注できない　ということですね。
dialogue.English: So you have work in progress, but you can't secure any new orders, is that right?

dialogue.content: そう金が回らない
dialogue.English: That's right. The cash flow isn't there.

dialogue.content: 商工会議所など、公的な機関には相談に行かれましたか？
dialogue.English: Have you gone to any public institutions, like the Chamber of Commerce and Industry, for advice?

dialogue.content: そんなもの無理だろう
dialogue.English: That probably wouldn't work.

dialogue.content: 雇用調整助成金や、持続化給付金のことはご存じでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Are you familiar with the Employment Adjustment Subsidy or the Sustainability Grant?

dialogue.content: 土木の売り上げは毎月一定じゃない
dialogue.English: Revenue in civil engineering isn't steady from month to month.

dialogue.content: 小売と違う
dialogue.English: It's different from retail.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。おっしゃるとおり、次の受注ができないと影響が大きいということですね。それは分かります。
dialogue.English: I see. As you say, not being able to get the next order has a huge impact. I understand that.

dialogue.content: もう無理だ
dialogue.English: I can't do this anymore.

dialogue.content: 聞いてもよろしいでしょうか？もしかしたら、死んだら楽になると考えていらっしゃいますか？
dialogue.English: May I ask? Are you perhaps thinking that dying would make things easier?

dialogue.content: 今ロープを用意している
dialogue.English: I have a rope ready right now.

dialogue.content: いま、お一人ですか？
dialogue.English: Are you alone right now?

dialogue.content: そうだ
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: そんな時でも、ここに相談に来てくださったのですね。
dialogue.English: Even in a moment like this, you chose to come here for support.

dialogue.content: これを最後に死のうと決めていた
dialogue.English: I had decided to end my life after this.

dialogue.content: いま、死んでしまったら、会社や、仕送りしているお子さんはどうなるのでしょうか。
dialogue.English: If you were to die now, what would happen to your company and the children you support?

dialogue.content: 申し訳ないと思っている
dialogue.English: I feel terrible about it.

dialogue.content: 申し訳ないと思われるのですね。
dialogue.English: You feel terrible about it.

dialogue.content: もう、もどれない
dialogue.English: There's no going back now.

dialogue.content: でも死なれてしまって、悲しんでいる、そういう人達の顔を想像できますか？
dialogue.English: But can you imagine the faces of those who would be grieving if you were to die?

dialogue.content: 妻はわたしを恨んでいる
dialogue.English: My wife resents me.

dialogue.content: 恨んでいる？　どうして？
dialogue.English: She resents you? Why is that?

dialogue.content: きつくしすぎた
dialogue.English: I was too hard on her.

dialogue.content: きつくした？　どういう風に？
dialogue.English: Too hard on her? In what way?

dialogue.content: 全部わたしが悪かった
dialogue.English: It was all my fault.

dialogue.content: 離婚する予定になっている
dialogue.English: We're planning to get a divorce.

dialogue.content: 直接、恨んでいると言われたのですか？
dialogue.English: Did she tell you directly that she resents you?

dialogue.content: そうに決まっているだろ
dialogue.English: Of course she does.

dialogue.content: 出て行ったんだから
dialogue.English: She left.

dialogue.content: 子供も連れて
dialogue.English: And took the children with her.

dialogue.content: 出て行ったから、恨まれていると思われたのですね。　仕送り必要なお子様の他に？
dialogue.English: So because she left, you think she resents you. Are there other children besides the ones who need the support payments?

dialogue.content: その子たちにだ
dialogue.English: It's for them.

dialogue.content: 仕送りは
dialogue.English: The support payments are.

dialogue.content: 一人になってわかった
dialogue.English: I realized it after I was alone.

dialogue.content: ひとりになってわかった？
dialogue.English: You realized it after being alone?

dialogue.content: 妻はよく支えてくれていた
dialogue.English: My wife was so supportive.

dialogue.content: ああ、奥様は、夫と子どもの家庭をよく支えてくださっていたのですね。
dialogue.English: Ah, so your wife was very supportive of you, her husband, and the family.

dialogue.content: 奥様に感謝の気持ちは？
dialogue.English: Do you feel grateful toward your wife?

dialogue.content: 今の状況じゃ言えるはずがない
dialogue.English: In this situation, there's no way I could say it.

dialogue.content: 今の状況は、借金とローンのことですね。言える筈がないと思われるのですね。
dialogue.English: "This situation" refers to the debt and the mortgage, right? And you feel there's no way you could say it.

dialogue.content: これ以上迷惑かけてはいけない
dialogue.English: I can't cause her any more trouble.

dialogue.content: これ以上迷惑をかけるとは、お金のことでしょうか？
dialogue.English: When you say "cause any more trouble," are you referring to money?

dialogue.content: そうだ妻にまでだめだ
dialogue.English: Yes. I can't burden my wife with this, too.

dialogue.content: ひとりで責任を取るつもりだ
dialogue.English: I intend to take responsibility alone.

dialogue.content: もし、ご主人が、今いなくなってしまったら、奥様はどう思われるでしょうか？
dialogue.English: If you were to be gone now, what do you think your wife would feel?

dialogue.content: わからない
dialogue.English: I don't know.

dialogue.content: 今まで、尽くしてくださった奥さまですよね？
dialogue.English: She's been devoted to you all this time, hasn't she?

dialogue.content: どちらにせよもう戻れない
dialogue.English: Either way, there's no going back.

dialogue.content: ロープを使う前に、感謝の言葉を伝えたいとは思いませんか？
dialogue.English: Before you use the rope, don't you want to express your gratitude to her?

dialogue.content: 今日ここで謝れただけで十分
dialogue.English: Just being able to apologize here today is enough.

dialogue.content: だれかにわかってもらえればよかった
dialogue.English: I just wanted someone to understand.

dialogue.content: 私は、奥様にあなたの、そのお気持ちをお伝えすることが出来ません。ごめんなさい。それでも、遺されるお子様が、これからどんな気持ちでお父さんがいない人生を歩むか？　一緒に考えてみたいのですが・・・
dialogue.English: I'm sorry, but I can't convey those feelings to your wife for you. Even so, I'd like for us to think together about how the children you'd leave behind will feel as they go through life without a father...

dialogue.content: そうあなたにいってもらえただけで良かった感謝します
dialogue.English: Just hearing you say that is enough. Thank you.

dialogue.content: 良かった。話を続けてもいいですか？
dialogue.English: I'm glad. May we continue talking?

dialogue.content: もう十分です。ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: That's enough. Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: （ロールプレイ、ありがとうございました。）
dialogue.English: (Thank you for the role-play.)
